resources.string: Unlock your device before completing or snoozing a reminder. Open Momentum, then try the reminder action again.
%1$s · Open Momentum to unlock before Done or Snooze.
Automation
Touch and hold the app icon for Add Task, Search and Today. Automation apps can also open Momentum task links.
Task links and parameters

Task links open Momentum and require an unlocked device for reading or changing tasks. Creation opens a private draft for review; an existing draft is preserved. Links do not return structured task results.
Create draft:\nmomentum://add?title=Review%20report\nOptional parameters: notes, due (YYYY-MM-DD), tags (comma-separated). The create-task host is also supported.
Find tasks:\nmomentum://find-tasks?query=report\nOpens the in-app search results.
Open task:\nmomentum://open-task?id=TASK_ID\nUses the current task ID. An active editor is preserved.
Complete task:\nmomentum://complete-task?title=Review%20report\nCompletes the first unfinished exact title match, ignoring A–Z letter case. Use unique titles. Completion can be undone in Momentum.
Reopen task:\nmomentum://reopen-task?id=TASK_ID\nReopens a completed task by ID, with Undo. An already unfinished or missing task is unchanged.
Plan for Today:\nmomentum://plan-task?id=TASK_ID\nUses Momentum’s existing planning rule.

URL-encode parameter values. Task IDs are the existing stable IDs, not titles. Creation keeps complete source notes in private draft storage. Task links are limited to 1,000,000 characters; search queries to 4,096.
